confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on crowd-sourced aggregates (Numbeo figures reported by Expatica, Expat Arrivals and Expatistan), so restaurant meal and coffee estimates are moderately reliable. The beer anchor is a judgement: the only found draft figure (USD 2.50 for 500ml) looked low for a restaurant serving, so it was raised toward typical Tampa restaurant draft prices and the source figure was not used directly. Cocktail uses a $12 to $15 range from price trackers with small samples. No Tampa wine-by-the-glass source was found, so wine_glass is inferred from the cocktail and beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tampa hotel and hostel markets, not from live listings, and carry the widest uncertainty; the hotel range is broad because Tampa rates vary a lot by season and event.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable non-US city is used. Anchors are based on Tampa, Florida as a mid-sized US metro with tourist-driven hotel pricing, with food anchors adjusted using US Southeast and Florida price levels. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, not a comparison to a specific city.
